milestones.name: Defeat Hornet
milestones.note: Required to access the acidic lake in northwest Greenpath

milestones.name: Obtain Shape of Unn
milestones.note: Charm given by Unn herself in a hidden area west of the acidic lake

milestones.name: Acquire Isma's Tear
milestones.note: Required to cross the acidic lake in Greenpath

milestones.name: Save Zote in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight can choose to save Zote from a Vengefly King along the path to Greenpath

milestones.name: Obtain Love Key
milestones.note: Found in Queen's Gardens; opens the door inside the Tower of Love

milestones.name: Neglect achievement
milestones.note: Granted by hitting Zote's shell if he dies (not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw)

milestones.name: Rivalry achievement
milestones.note: Granted by defeating Zote as the final boss of the first trial in the Colosseum of Fools

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Lush green area with acid lakes, vengefly enemies, home to Hornet boss

zones.name: Acidic Lake
zones.note: Located at the northwest part of Greenpath; accessible after defeating Hornet; contains a stone statue of Unn and a Bench
zones.fingerprintHint: Acid water lake in northwest Greenpath

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.note: Town where Zote reappears after being saved in Greenpath

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.note: Corridor leading back to the storerooms where Zote can be found again

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.note: Area where Zote is found stuck in spider webs, presumably captured by the beasts

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.note: Zote is found in the resting area and becomes the final boss of the first trial if saved twice

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Location where the Love Key is found

zones.name: Tower of Love
zones.note: Door unlocked by the Love Key; the Collector can be fought inside

abilities.name: Shape of Unn
abilities.note: Found in a hidden area to the west of the acidic lake, given by Unn herself

abilities.name: Isma's Tear
abilities.note: Allows crossing of the acidic lake in northwest Greenpath

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Referenced as the deadline for saving Zote; if not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw, Zote dies

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.grants: Unlocks door of Tower of Love
abilities.note: Covered in padding, bears a symbol of love; opens the door inside the Tower of Love where the Collector can be fought

bosses.name: Hornet
bosses.note: Must be defeated to access the acidic lake in northwest Greenpath; mysterious princess-protector of Hallownest's ruins; wields a Needle and thread

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles along the path leading to Greenpath; Knight can choose to save or leave Zote

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of the first trial if Knight saved Zote in both Greenpath and Deepnest; deals no damage due to shellwood nail; defeating grants Rivalry achievement

bosses.name: The Collector
bosses.note: Can be fought inside the Tower of Love after unlocking the door with the Love Key
